# Ithaca College

> > Ithaca College is a comprehensive liberal arts institution in New York State offering undergraduate and graduate programs across the School of Humanities and Sciences, School of Music, Theatre, and Dance, and other professional schools.

The college features distinctive programs including New York State's only comprehensive B.A. writing program, the Ithaca Young Writers Institute, and nationally recognized music and theatre programs. Ithaca College emphasizes experiential learning, creative expression, and preparing students for careers in the arts, humanities, sciences, and professional fields.

## Academic Programs & Departments

- [Department of Writing](https://www.ithaca.edu/academics/school-humanities-and-sciences/writing): NY State's only comprehensive B.A. writing program in School of H&S
- [Department of Sociology](https://www.ithaca.edu/academics/school-humanities-and-sciences/sociology): Sociology department in School of H&S focused on social change education
- [Curriculum Details](https://www.ithaca.edu/ithaca-young-writers-institute/curriculum-details): Imaginative Writing course details for Young Writers Institute program
